notes.title: Playtest Patch Update v1.5
notes.notes:
HamSumo Playtest Patch v1.4 notes:

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where performing a duck jump would cause states to overlap, causing numerous unintended effects
 - Fixed an issue where Hamozuna's level 2 star move would persist after a KO
 - Fixed an issue where colliding with a new Ground collider while still colliding with another would cause the player to become Airborne
 - Adjusted the bounds of the Ship stage to prevent Hamoichi self-KOing when performing her level 3 star move in some parts of the stage
 - Fixed an issue where Hamstein's level 3 star move would cause him to explode

notes.title: Playtest Patch Update v1.4
notes.notes:
HamSumo Playtest Patch v1.4 notes:

Bug Fixes

 - Fixed an issue where ducking after fastfalling would cause the ducking and moving states to overlap
 - Fixed an issue where shadows would grow extremely large under some circumstances
 - Fixed an issue where boost charge would persist after a KO if the button was held
 - Fixed an issue where Hamozuna's level 3 would persist after a KO
 - Made level 3 star moves fully invincible, preventing scenarios where it would be possible to be put into the recoil state while the move was active, causing unintended effects
 - Fixed an issue where Hamstein would no longer be able to jump after drinking 3 Size Serums
 - Fixed an issue where Hamoichi would KO herself if she used her level 3 on the edge of the stump stage
 
New Stage
 - Spaceship stage was added!
 The glass walls of the ship can be broken if they take enough damage, causing the stage to become more and more precarious over the course of each battle!
